fullContentHtml:
UPSC IES/ ISS Interview Date 2026 – Full Details

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the Interview Date for the post of Indian Statistical Service (ISS) & Indian Economics Service (IES) Recruitment 2026 on the official website of UPSC. This recruitment was released for 44 posts. Applications for the UPSC IES/ ISS Recruitment 2026 were accepted from February 11, 2026, to March 3, 2026. The examination is going to be conducted on 02-05 November 2026. Candidates who qualified for this examination can download their UPSC IES/ ISS Interview Date 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 11 February 2026
  • Application Start Date : 11 February 2026
  • Last Date : 03 March 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 03 March 2026
  • Correction / Edit Form : 05-11 March 2026
  • Exam Date : 19, 20 & 21 June 2026
  • Admit Card : 12 June 2026
  • Result : 04 August 2026
  • Interview Date : 02-05 November 2026
  • Candidates will be redirected to the login page, here they need to provide their following details-:
  • Registration No.
  • DOB
  • Captcha Code
  • Have to Click on the “Login” tab.

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 200/-
  • SC, SC, Female, PH : 0/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UPSC IES/ ISS Interview Date 2026?

UPSC IES/ ISS Interview Date 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
